messages:
Jordan (AE): Quick sync: Prospect 'BlueFjord' wants a 10-business-day POC. Scope: 3 micro-flows (intent routing, notes summarization, reply-tone normalization). Need: compact prompt inventory, 100 golds/flow, eval script, headline cost, and security/KMS path by EOD tomorrow. @Priya @Sam @Leah
Priya (SE): Copy. Hosted baseline unless they insist on customer-managed keys. I'll draft a minimal prompt set with expected output shapes and 100 golden examples each.
Sam (Solutions Eng): For eval, 100 samples/flow is fine for quick turnaround. I'll prepare harness and a runnable command: `./eval/run.py --suite bluefjord_quick --n 100 --model redwood-hosted-v1`
Leah (PM): Proposed acceptance gates: routing accuracy >= 0.75, summary ROUGE-L >= 0.58, tone-accept >= 80% on 150-sample blind audit, p95 latency < 600ms. Midpoint demo day 5. Sound OK?
Jordan (AE): Yes. Also they flagged encryption and audit logs in legal. Assume we'll need to present hosted KMS options + Dedicated uplift.
Priya (SE): Prompt inventory (compact, annotated):
1) routing_v1: "Return one label from [billing, onboarding, bug, feature, other]. Return exactly the label."
2) summary_v1: "Summarize conversation in 3 bullets. First bullet: actions."
3) tone_v1: "Rewrite agent reply to be professional and empathetic. Max 140 chars."
4) safety_v1: "If input violates policy, return 'BLOCK' with a short reason; otherwise 'OK' then proceed."
Priya (SE): I'll include expected schema for summary (bullets array) and for routing (single token). 100 golds/flow and 20 golden spot-checks for manual hallucination audit.
Sam (Solutions Eng): Eval output format: per-sample {id, flow, pred, gold, latency_ms, tokens_out, confidence}. Aggregated report will include accuracy/ROUGE/exact-match and a hallucination flag summary. Example parse: `jq '.results | map({flow: .flow, metric: .metric})' report.json`
pricing-bot: provisional: hosted_10bd_baseline_estimate = $X (based on qps 1.6 avg, peak 8, ~280 tokens). Dedicated_uplift_estimate = +35% (placeholder). Provide assumptions with numbers when finalizing.
Sam (Solutions Eng): Security: I'll take questionnaire first pass. Flag: if they require customer-managed keys for control plane, we need Dedicated and Legal/PS involvement.
Leah (PM): Action items: 1) SE (Priya) -> prompt JSON + 100 golds/flow (tomorrow AM). 2) Solutions Eng (Sam) -> eval harness + run instructions + sample report. 3) AE (Jordan) -> collect any customer-provided examples and clarify KMS ask. 4) Pricing -> finalize headline by tomorrow noon. 5) Security -> draft answers and escalate if control-plane isolation requested.
Jordan (AE): I'll ask customer for 150 sample conversations to seed gold sets. Also confirm kickoff earliest Monday.
Priya (SE): Will keep prompts minimal and instrument each response with token_count and response_ms. Also add a confidence field to help triage.
Sam (Solutions Eng): I'll seed the harness with a quick smoke test and post the staging link. Command sample: `./scripts/smoke_eval.sh --suite bluefjord_quick`
sec-bot: note: hosted default retention for POC logs = 30d. Customer-managed KMS available on Dedicated; on-prem requires contract review.
Leah (PM): Timeline: kickoff Mon, mid-POC demo day 5, final decision call day 10. I'll post the POC runbook with acceptance checklist once artifacts land.
pricing-bot: reminder: include qps and token assumptions when requesting a firm quote.
Jordan (AE): Great. If SEs can drop artifacts tomorrow AM I'll present scope and costs to the customer Thurs. Thanks all.
Priya (SE): Uploading prompts + golds to POC drive now, will paste link.
Sam (Solutions Eng): Working on security draft and eval harness; will attach sample report.
Leah (PM): Closing sync. Ping here for blockers.
